asm_note: byte_matched_asm_* is hand-written assembly (ASM_UNITS, kind asm, the GTE/renderer region); byte_matched_library_asm_* is library assembly (LIBRARY_ASM_UNITS, kind library_asm, Sony Runtime Library variant modules). Ranges: config/asm_regions.json. <prefix>_functions counts every mapped label (routines + tables in .text); <prefix>_bytes adds the unit's data definitions. Both are counted only here: excluded from every C count, from payload_byte_coverage_percent and from the certified library.
coverage_note: Payload includes data, padding and runtime code. This is a conservative measured byte coverage; the complete game function denominator is not established.
